conclusion: Both FLAC and MP4 browser decode preserve all96000 signed16 samples in each of6 channels; conversion-policy diagnosis explains nonidentical host/browser float hashes. Direct and MSE playback retain6 channel identities after seeking to0.8s and reach EOF. Stereo downmix, swapped-channel and malformed-input controls reject; contexts close.
limits: Capability and fidelity question is resolved for this16-bit48kHz synthetic destination profile. Original proposal explicitly asks preservation of six distinct channels and contains no speed or resource hypothesis; physical speaker routing,24-bit and production integration are outside this completed profile.
